system.name: GoodKit
system.one_liner: a VM-introspection framework that runs the observer as a separate guest OS instead of hypervisor-embedded logic

components.name: VMM
components.role: existing VM-monitor process hosting both the target and the observer

components.name: task_struct
components.role: kernel data structure inside the target that the observer inspects, guarded by lock icons

components.name: Observer
components.role: the observer's software context, running as a separate guest OS that hosts the introspection logic

components.name: Custom obs service
components.role: tenant-supplied introspection logic built on top of LibGK

components.name: LibGK
components.role: GoodKit's introspection library exposing its programming model/API to observer services

components.name: GKModule
components.role: in-guest module that enforces an access-control list and communicates with GKProbe

components.name: GKBuilder
components.role: new VMM subcomponent that launches both target and observer guests via KVM run, sets up the observer's EPT memory slots, and receives symbols and configuration

components.name: GKProbe
components.role: new VMM subcomponent that communicates with GKModule and handles the observer's VM exits and KVM API calls

components.name: Hypervisor
components.role: existing hypervisor layer beneath the VMM hosting the EPT structures

components.name: EPT Target
components.role: new extended page table built for the target, with some regions shared into the observer's EPT

components.name: EPT Obs
components.role: new extended page table built for the observer, combining mapped target regions and private slots

components.name: Tenant
components.role: the cloud tenant who configures and deploys the observer through GKBuilder

content.key_idea: GoodKit runs the introspection observer as its own guest OS, with two new VMM components (GKBuilder, GKProbe) launching it, wiring its access to selected target memory through per-observer EPT slots, and mediating its VM exits, instead of embedding introspection logic in the hypervisor.

summary: GoodKit is a VM-introspection framework that runs an observer as a separate guest OS instead of embedding introspection logic in the hypervisor. This figure shows GoodKit's architecture inside a two-layer existing infrastructure (VMM over Hypervisor), color-coded by origin: gray for existing Hypervisor/VMM layers, white for new VMM subcomponents, yellow for the observer's own context. Two new components act as hubs. GKBuilder launches both the target and the observer via KVM run (steps 1-2), receives tenant configuration (3) and target kernel symbols (5), and pushes an access-control list to the observer's GKModule (4). GKProbe handles the observer's VM exits and KVM API calls and talks to GKModule (steps 6-8). The observer's EPT maps selected target-memory regions, guarded by lock icons on the target's task_struct, alongside private slots, giving it controlled, direct access to target state.
